title: Explicit exact etale and pro-etale scalar equivalences
statement: For a scheme X in universe u and a commutative ring k in universe u+1, compose the AsSmall sheaf equivalence on the original etale (respectively pro-etale) site with the inverse of constant scalar restriction [def-coef-constant-scalar-restriction]. This gives explicit additive equivalences from fixed-k module sheaves to modules over the constant ring on the small models. Define their termwise cochain functors and localized pro-etale derived functor. The pro-etale termwise functor is the prescribed [def-sfb-fixed-scalar-complex-model], and its localized functor is an equivalence with the canonical factorization isomorphism. All data comes from these specified equivalences.

def fixedScalarEtaleSheafEquivalence (X : Scheme.{u}) (k : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing k] :
    Sheaf (X.smallEtaleTopology) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k) ≌
      ConstantCompletion.Mod
        (ConstantCompletion.constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, u} X) k)
